text:
sophie_cs: Hey team — customer (org_id: org_8421) says their free-tier credits vanished this morning even though they were active yesterday. They show 0 remaining in dashboard but invoice still lists unused promotional grant. :thinking:

alex_ops: Which grant ID? Any recent plan changes?

sophie_cs: Grant ID g_2025_spring, applied 2025-03-01. Customer upgraded to a paid plan yesterday but expects promo to be consumed first. They claim tokens were billed against paid balance.

sam_account: Customer sent screenshots of dashboard vs invoice. Dashboard: "Free credits: 0", Usage page shows tokens charged to paid plan. Invoice line item shows promo_grant g_2025_spring still listed with unused balance of 5000 tokens.

ryan_billing: Tagging in. @linda_eng can you check metering logs? This sounds like credit burn-order mismatch after plan change.

linda_eng: Looking at logs for org_8421... initial query: `SELECT * FROM token_usage WHERE org_id='org_8421' AND ts > '2026-03-01' ORDER BY ts;`

linda_eng: Quick findings: on upgrade event (2026-03-16T03:12Z) we applied a migration path that switches the "active_credit_pool" pointer before reassigning in-flight invoice lines. There are events where paid pool wins allocation during the same second.

alex_ops: So race between plan-upgrade handler and credit-assigner? Any evidence of FIFO vs LIFO policy change?

linda_eng: Yes — billing config default is FIFO (consume oldest promo first). But a recent change accidentally flipped the in-memory prioritizer for ephemeral allocations during upgrades to "most-recent-first" for performance reasons. That made paid balance be preferred.

support_bot: Ticket #45683 updated: escalated to billing-engineering.

ryan_billing: Can we reproduce? If yes, we need a hotfix and a credit adjustment for the customer.

linda_eng: Repro steps I used locally:
```
# simulate upgrade and immediate request
INSERT INTO plans (org_id, plan, ts) VALUES ('org_8421','paid','2026-03-16T03:12:01Z');
-- immediately send request
SELECT allocate_tokens('org_8421', 1200);
-- inspect allocation table
SELECT * FROM allocation_log WHERE org_id='org_8421' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 5;
```

linda_eng: In the failing run allocation_log shows: `source: paid_account, amount: 1200` then `promo g_2025_spring still shows 5000 available`.

sam_account: Oof. Customer-facing impact: they think promo will be used first; surprise billing.

ryan_billing: Proposed fixes: 1) short-term: run a reconciliation that transfers the charged tokens back to promo pool and credit the invoice (manual adj). 2) mid-term: revert prioritizer change and add a locking step during plan change. 3) add observability: alert when allocation comes from paid pool within Xs of upgrade event.

alex_ops: Agreed. Ryan, can billing author the manual credit? Sophie, please ask customer for a preferred verification window.

sophie_cs: Pinged customer — they want the correction this week and a note about what happened. Also asked for the exact timestamp of their observed charge (they provided 2026-03-16T03:12:02Z).

linda_eng: I'll prepare a patch to force FIFO during transition and add a 2s lock around the migration. Patch branch: `fix/credit-priority-lock`

ryan_billing: Manual adj: will refund 1200 tokens to promo g_2025_spring and apply credit to invoice 2026-03-16-ORG8421. ETA 2 hours. I'll post the adj id once done.

support_bot: Billing adjustment completed: adj_77821.

ryan_billing: adj_77821 done. Invoice updated and customer notified. Also added a postmortem note on internal wiki.

sam_account: Customer confirmed they see promo balance restored and invoice credit. :thumbsup:

alex_ops: Next steps: Linda submits PR, QA run on staging, then deploy. Also add unit test around allocation ordering.

linda_eng: PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/123/pull/89 - includes test and a metrics delta.

sophie_cs: I'll close the support ticket after customer ack and include explanation + timeline.

sam_account: Please track as sev-3 until patch is in prod and verification is done.

linda_eng: Will monitor for any other orgs that hit the same window. Running a sweep query tonight to find upgrade events + allocations within 5s.

ryan_billing: Thanks all — good catch. We'll follow up with a small communication to affected customers if the sweep finds more.

sophie_cs: Closing note: customer appreciated quick response, wants confirmation when the PR is merged. I'll reopen thread if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
